claims.text: Macaw currently has a command line interface and a Telegram bot interface that supports multi-modal interactions such as text, speech, image, and click.
The Telegram interface allows interaction across various devices and operating systems, including Android, iOS, Linux, Mac OS, and Windows.
Macaw's design is modular, allowing for easy configuration and addition of new interfaces in the future.
